t: This Bosch Straight Shank Double-Flute Brad Point Wood Drill Bit set offers precise drilling in both soft and hard wood, suitable for creating through-holes and pocket holes. Ideal for joiners working on cabinetry or DIY enthusiasts tackling furniture assembly, the set features extremely sharp drill bits with a centring tip for exact hole positioning. High-quality shoulder cutters with precise edges produce tear-free holes. The two flutes prevent material from clogging and ensure good material removal, delivering exact results for various wood drilling tasks.
